sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: Prometheus Laboratories holds a patent on a method for dosing a drug. The method involves measuring blood levels and adjusting the dose based on those levels. Mayo Collaborative Services uses a similar method. Prometheus sued for patent infringement. The lower courts found the patent invalid. They ruled the claim covers a natural law.

paragraphs: This case defines what medical methods can be patented. It affects how doctors and researchers use drug-dosing information. It shapes the balance between private patents and public knowledge.
